_note: Англійська версія демонстраційних тварин (ключ – папка в database/seeders/photos/pets). Умови прилаштування в демо-даних складені з кількох типових речень, тому перекладаються за таблицею adoption_sentences.

adoption_sentences.Прилаштування після знайомства та співбе: Adoption follows a meeting and an interview with the foster carer.
adoption_sentences.Утримання вдома, без самовигулу; захисні: Indoor living only, no unsupervised outdoor access; safety nets on the windows, a scratching post and a carrier.
adoption_sentences.Проживання в оселі, без ланцюга; щоденні: Living indoors, never on a chain; daily walks, secure gear and humane training.
adoption_sentences.Готовність до ветеринарного догляду та п: Willingness to provide veterinary care and to keep in touch with the shelter afterwards.
adoption_sentences.Потрібен регулярний догляд за довгою шер: Regular grooming of the long coat is required.
adoption_sentences.Потрібен час на активні прогулянки та ро: Time for active walks and mental exercise is required.

cats/1.name: Felix
cats/1.story: After his previous carers moved away, Felix found a temporary home with a volunteer. We are looking for a permanent home for him with room to play and rest.
cats/1.behavior: Sociable and curious, he likes watching people and playing with a teaser wand. He gets used to a new home gradually.

cats/2.name: Leo
cats/2.story: Leo went into foster care when his family could no longer look after him. Now he is waiting to meet his new carers.
cats/2.behavior: Calm and attentive to people, he loves high perches and unhurried play. Needs regular brushing.

cats/3.name: Mango
cats/3.story: Mango was spotted near an apartment block entrance and taken off the street. In this demo story, the search for his previous owners led nowhere.
cats/3.behavior: Lively and playful, he is fascinated by boxes and toys. After an active game he happily rests next to a person.

cats/4.name: Pearl
cats/4.story: Pearl lives in foster care after her carer asked for help finding her a new family. We are looking for a cosy home for her.
cats/4.behavior: Gentle, she enjoys quiet company and a sleeping spot of her own. She doesn’t like being picked up before she has got to know someone.

cats/5.name: Fudge
cats/5.story: Neighbours in a courtyard used to feed Fudge, and later a temporary shelter was found for her. The next step is a permanent family.
cats/5.behavior: Curious, she likes watching the world through the window and exploring new toys. She keeps her distance from strangers at first.

cats/6.name: Martin
cats/6.story: Martin was taken from a courtyard into a foster flat. Now we are looking for a home with enough time for daily play.
cats/6.behavior: Active and eager to interact with people, he loves chasing a ball. Needs play breaks throughout the day.

cats/7.name: Peach
cats/7.story: Peach is temporarily staying with friends of his previous family. Volunteers are helping to find him permanent owners.
cats/7.behavior: Even-tempered, he likes a predictable routine and quiet evenings together. Introductions to other animals should be gradual.

cats/8.name: Bun
cats/8.story: Bun ended up in foster care after changes in her carers’ lives. We are looking for a home with a steady routine and attentive people.
cats/8.behavior: Affectionate, she loves soft beds and short play sessions. She is happy to spend time nearby but sometimes needs to be alone.

cats/9.name: Sky
cats/9.story: Sky was found near a residential building and taken into temporary care. We are looking for a family ready for a patient introduction.
cats/9.behavior: Observant and sensitive to loud noises. Once settled, he is happy to socialise and enjoys interactive toys.

cats/10.name: Malva
cats/10.story: Malva lives with a volunteer who is helping her find a new family. Her future home needs time to look after her long coat.
cats/10.behavior: Calm, she likes resting near people and choosing cosy spots. Needs gentle, regular brushing.

cats/11.name: Plush
cats/11.story: Plush went to a foster family because his previous carers could no longer keep him. He is waiting for a cosy home of his own.
cats/11.behavior: Unhurried, he loves hiding places and watching the world from the windowsill. He feels more comfortable without sudden movements or forced cuddles.

cats/12.name: Rudy
cats/12.story: Rudy was taken from a courtyard where he was looking for food and human attention. Now we are looking for a permanent home with a safe space to play.
cats/12.behavior: Energetic, he loves stretching, running and exploring the home. Responds well to shared play and attention.

cats/13.name: Patch
cats/13.story: Patch turned up near a building where caring residents noticed her. Her foster carer is helping her find a family.
cats/13.behavior: Playful, she loves batting small toys around and lying on a soft blanket. She approaches new people at her own pace.

cats/14.name: Mia
cats/14.story: Mia was taken into foster care from the courtyard of a high-rise. We are looking for a family who will give her a calm adjustment and daily attention.
cats/14.behavior: Attentive and curious, she likes sitting nearby and watching the household routine. Loves playing with a teaser wand.

cats/15.name: Tiger
cats/15.story: Tiger came into volunteers’ care after living in a courtyard. Now we are looking for a safe home and a permanent family for him.
cats/15.behavior: Lively, he loves climbing and exploring new places. Needs a scratching post, toys and a chance to burn off energy.

cats/16.name: Smoky
cats/16.story: Smoky was given temporary shelter after residents of a nearby building asked for help. We are looking for attentive carers and a calm home rhythm for her.
cats/16.behavior: Gentle but cautious with strangers at first. She loves cosy corners and short petting sessions.

cats/17.name: Toffee
cats/17.story: Toffee is in home foster care while volunteers look for permanent carers. She needs a family ready to look after her fluffy coat.
cats/17.behavior: Calm and attentive, she happily rests near people. Enjoys unhurried play and quiet company.

cats/18.name: Snowflake
cats/18.story: Snowflake is temporarily living with a carer after family changes for her previous owners. We are looking for a stable and cosy home for her.
cats/18.behavior: Reserved at first meeting, she values her personal space. Likes quiet places and a predictable routine.

cats/19.name: Amber
cats/19.story: Amber was taken into foster care from a courtyard where people had been feeding him for a while. He is waiting for a family to share quiet evenings with.
cats/19.behavior: Unhurried, he likes dozing somewhere warm and watching people. Happy to join in short games.

cats/20.name: Oscar
cats/20.story: Oscar was left in the temporary care of acquaintances, who asked for help finding him a home. We are looking for attentive permanent carers.
cats/20.behavior: Outgoing, he is curious about new things and happily greets people. Needs daily play and a quiet place to rest.

dogs/1.name: Cookie
dogs/1.story: Cookie is temporarily living with a carer after his previous family moved away. We are looking for people who will have time for walks and company.
dogs/1.behavior: Lively, he loves exploring new routes and working for treats. Needs consistent training and daily activity.

dogs/2.name: Luna
dogs/2.story: Luna went into foster care after her previous carers’ circumstances changed. We are looking for an active family for her.
dogs/2.behavior: Attentive to people and interested in games and training. Needs mental challenges and plenty of time for walks.

dogs/3.name: Winston
dogs/3.story: Winston was taken in temporarily by friends of a family who could no longer look after him. Now we are looking for a permanent home.
dogs/3.behavior: Unhurried, he likes resting nearby and walking at a calm pace. Responds best to gentle, consistent training.

dogs/4.name: Bruno
dogs/4.story: Bruno is in home foster care while we look for new carers for him. It is important that the family has time for daily company.
dogs/4.behavior: Friendly, he is interested in toys and loves being close to people. Needs moderate walks and quiet rest.

dogs/5.name: Berta
dogs/5.story: Berta was taken into care after her temporary carers asked for help. We are looking for a family who values calm companionship.
dogs/5.behavior: Even-tempered, she loves unhurried walks and human attention. Meets new animals gradually.

dogs/6.name: Fox
dogs/6.story: Fox went into foster care when his previous carers asked for help finding him a new home. He needs active owners.
dogs/6.behavior: Energetic, he loves ball games and walks in nature. Needs activities that combine movement and training.

dogs/7.name: Ray
dogs/7.story: Volunteers took Ray in temporarily after caring people reached out. Now we are looking for a family with time for an active lifestyle.
dogs/7.behavior: Attentive and quick to join in shared activities. Loves scent games and needs regular mental stimulation.

dogs/8.name: Nora
dogs/8.story: Nora lives with a foster family who are helping her find permanent carers. She needs a home with a clear and friendly routine.
dogs/8.behavior: Loves contact with people and active games. Her reaction to other animals should be checked during a supervised introduction.

dogs/9.name: Jack
dogs/9.story: Jack was taken into foster care after residents of a courtyard asked for help. We are looking for a family who loves being active together.
dogs/9.behavior: Curious and lively, he loves following scents. Needs on-lead walks and training in calm behaviour.

dogs/10.name: Cloudy
dogs/10.story: Cloudy was given temporary shelter after she was spotted near residential buildings. Now we are looking for attentive permanent carers for her.
dogs/10.behavior: Friendly and curious, she loves walks and playing with soft toys. Needs regular coat care.

dogs/11.name: Bailey
dogs/11.story: Bailey ended up in foster care because his previous family could no longer keep him. We are looking for a new home with daily walks.
dogs/11.behavior: Friendly with people, he is passionate about scents and search games. Needs a secure lead on walks.

dogs/12.name: Daisy
dogs/12.story: Daisy was taken into temporary care after a family who couldn’t keep her asked for help. Now she is waiting to meet her future owners.
dogs/12.behavior: Curious and active, she loves exploring new routes. Needs consistent training and treat-search games.

dogs/13.name: Goldie
dogs/13.story: Goldie is temporarily living with a volunteer who is helping her find a permanent family. Her new home will need time for company and coat care.
dogs/13.behavior: Lively, she loves attention, walks and playing together. When meeting new people, she responds best without rush or pressure.

dogs/14.name: Bagel
dogs/14.story: Bagel stayed in temporary care after his carers’ circumstances changed. He is looking for a family for a calm home life.
dogs/14.behavior: Loves being close to people, resting on his bed and playing in short bursts. Needs walks at a moderate pace.

dogs/15.name: Archie
dogs/15.story: Archie is staying with a foster carer while we look for a permanent family. He needs people ready to devote time to training and activity.
dogs/15.behavior: Active and observant, he loves shared tasks and exploring the area. Needs a balance of activity and rest.

dogs/16.name: Teddy
dogs/16.story: Teddy went into home foster care after his previous carers asked for help. We are looking for calm and consistent carers for him.
dogs/16.behavior: Independent, he values his personal space and an unhurried introduction. Needs regular brushing and calm handling.

dogs/17.name: Pixel
dogs/17.story: Pixel is temporarily living with a volunteer family. We are looking for active owners ready for training and daily activities.
dogs/17.behavior: Playful and curious, he loves short training games. Needs a gradual introduction to new situations and enough rest.

dogs/18.name: Sunny
dogs/18.story: Sunny went into foster care when the search for a permanent family began. Her future owners will need time for training and adjustment.
dogs/18.behavior: Curious, she happily plays and explores her surroundings. Needs consistent training, toys and a clear routine.

dogs/19.name: Millie
dogs/19.story: Millie is temporarily staying with a carer who asked for help finding her a home. She is looking for an attentive family for home life.
dogs/19.behavior: Affectionate, she likes staying close to people and resting somewhere cosy. Settles into a new home with the help of a calm routine.

dogs/20.name: Tosha
dogs/20.story: Tosha went into foster care after the people looking after him temporarily asked for help. We are looking for a home with a gentle approach.
dogs/20.behavior: Cautious at first meeting, he later happily stays close. Needs calm contact and gradual exposure to city sounds.

locations.Домашня перетримка у волонтера, Овідіопо: Home foster care with a volunteer, Ovidiopol.
